'''Olaris''', also known as '''Olaris Reclamation Base''', was a [[City/Legends|city]] on the ruined [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. Founded as part of the [[Taris Resettlement Initiative]], Olaris served as the headquarters of the restoration project and all Republic operations on the world.

==History==
The [[Taris Resettlement Initiative]] was begun by the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] not long after the end of the [[Great Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. During the resulting [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], the Senate decided to rebuild the shattered world&mdash;which had been [[Destruction of Taris|destroyed]] over [[3956 BBY|300 years]] earlier by [[Darth Malak]] in an attempt to kill the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Bastila Shan]]&mdash;as a demonstration of the Republic's ability to overcome the destruction wrought by the Sith.<ref name="Codex">{{TORcite|type=codex|Republic Restoration}}</ref>

In [[3643 BBY]], Olaris was run by the [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] [[Leontyne Saresh]], the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] planetary governor. The city featured the planet's main [[Olaris Spaceport|spaceport]], as well as a [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] and [[Medcenter/Legends|medcenter]]. Many of the different teams and crews in the [[Republic Resettlement Zone]] were based there, and Olaris was one of Zone's two major military bases&mdash;the other being [[Tower command station|Waypoint Station Aurek]] to the west.<ref name="TOR" />

The city was frequently besieged by the native [[rakghoul]]s, and as a result was guarded by massive walls built out of metal salvaged from the ruins of the former [[Ecumenopolis/Legends|city-planet]]. By 3643 BBY, the two outer sections of the city had become overrun with rakghouls, forcing the military to create a barricade at the city's gates to hold back the savage [[Sithspawn/Legends|Sithspawn]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Olaris was created for ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] released by [[BioWare]] on [[December 20]], [[2011]]. It serves as the main hub for players on the Republic version of Taris, featuring the normal planetary vendors and class trainers. It also features a cantina, a medcenter, and a taxi station, as well as access to the planet's spaceport and the players' ships.<ref name="TOR" />

Several missions available to players begin or end in the city, and players receive the planet's Bonus Series from [[Strom (aide)|Strom]] and [[Bardo (aide)|Bardo]] in the spaceport.<ref name="TOR" /> Olaris also marks the first appearance chronologically of Saresh, who becomes [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] after the [[Hunter (individual)|Bounty Hunter]] class kills or drives out the current Chancellor, [[Dorian Janarus]].<ref name="Bounty">{{TORcite|type=class|Bounty Hunter|Act III|The Founder}}</ref>
